<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/checkout_report"}
#docs
Hosted checkout sessions (new sign-ups and purchases) first opened in [`start`, `end`] (civil days in the business timezone). The funnel counts a session at a step when it reached that step or a later one, as the `checkout_funnel` report does; conversion is completed ÷ opened, as `checkout_conversion`. Revenue is the paid total of each completed checkout's purchase invoice or its subscription's first invoice. Recovery counts sessions CREATED in the window that completed after a reminder email, as `checkout_reminders` and `checkout_recovered_revenue` do. With `compare=true`, `previous` holds the same figures for the same number of days just before. Money is integer minor units in `currency` (the business currency unless `currency` is set), converted at each amount's day; a currency with no rate is left out and named in `missing_rates`. `live` ignores the window: sessions used in the last 5 minutes and opened in the last 30. `tracking` holds first-party visit figures (no cookies; GPC and DNT honoured): only visits whose page ran in a browser count, with the referrer host, UTM tags, device, browser and the edge's country; `tracking.since` is the first tracked view, so a window that starts earlier is partly untracked. `country` and `device` narrow every figure to sessions with a matching tracked visit.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | `string` | **yes** | First civil day of the window, in the business timezone |
| `end` | `string` | **yes** | Last civil day of the window, inclusive. At most 366 days. |
| `compare` | `string` | no | Also return the previous window of the same length |
| `currency` | `string` | no | Report in this currency only. Default: every currency, converted into the business currency |
| `payment_link` | `string` | no | Only sessions from this payment link (`plink_…`) |
| `plan` | `string` | no | Only sessions whose plan item is this plan product |
| `country` | `string` | no | Only sessions with a tracked visit from this country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, from the visitor's request) |
| `device` | `string` | no | Only sessions with a tracked visit from this device category |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `checkout_report`. One of `checkout_report`. |
| `business` | `string` | The business id. |
| `start` | `string` | The first day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `end` | `string` | The last day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `previous_start` | `string` | The first day of the previous window. |
| `previous_end` | `string` | The last day of the previous window. |
| `timezone` | `string` | The business time zone. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency of the money figures. |
| `missing_rates` | `array of string` | Currencies with no exchange rate, left out of the money figures. |
| `totals` | `object` | The window's figures. |
| `previous` | `object` | The same figures for the previous window; null unless `compare=true`. |
| `live` | `object` | Right now, whatever the window. |
| `days` | `array of object` | The window's days, in order. |
| `series` | `object` | Per-day figures, one per day in `days`. |
| `funnel` | `array of object` | The funnel, in order. |
| `links` | `array of object` | By payment link, by revenue. |
| `payment_methods` | `array of object` | By method. |
| `failures` | `object` | Payment attempts and the newest refusal of each session. |
| `recovery` | `object` | Reminder emails and the checkouts they recovered. |
| `coupons` | `object` | Sessions with and without a coupon, and the codes used. |
| `countries` | `array of object` | By country. |
| `time_to_complete` | `array of object` | Time from opened to paid. |
| `tracking` | `object` | First-party visit tracking over the window (sessions whose page ran in a browser). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The checkout report |
| `400` | Invalid window, unknown payment link or plan |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/checkout_report?start=2026-03-14&end=2026-04-14" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
